referenceFunction.generalComment: Production of a ventilation system for a school with schoolrooms, canteen and multi-purpose hall. The inventory is based on a building with a total heated gross floor area of 5603 m2 and a total nominal air flow of 31620 m3/h, total weight of the components: 8393 kg/Unit, building with a specific air flow rate of 5.6 m3/h per m2 heated gross floor area. Data from call of bid including components for air handling units, ducts including insulation, air valves, roof-hoods, dampers, fire dampers, silencers. The data represent a ductwork mainly made of galvanized steel and includes air handling units mainly with heat recovery. System with central air handling units. Building without ground heat exchanger.; UUID: c5b028a8-be72-30da-b7f3-3f0a958b3574
